crossRefs.note: I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,
which my lips promised, and my mouth spoke, when I was in distress.
Make vows to Yahweh your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.
I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people.
I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.

When you vow a vow to God, don’t defer to pay it; for he has no pleasure in fools. Pay that which you vow.
I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.
Be exalted, Yahweh, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.

translations.web: Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.
translations.bsb: Your vows are upon me, O God; I will render thank offerings to You.
translations.kjv: Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will render praises
translations.asv: Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will render thank-offerings unto thee.
